foto-01.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: TRIST. ONE synthetic studio PHOTOGRAPH. Real camera realism, believable skin texture and hair, soft even neutral studio light. No illustration or cartoon. Subject: a teenage boy with medium brown skin and short curly black hair in a blue shirt. Visual content: Clearly sad human FACE: inner brows drawn upward, downturned mouth corners, lower gaze, subdued expression. Subtle moist eyes permitted, no huge cartoon tears. No props, no scene.  Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Full head, ears, neck and upper shoulders, scalp entirely inside frame and white margin above it; natural portrait crop at upper chest. Human face large, directly readable. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.

review.scope: Revisió visual de producció pel mateix assistent que ha preparat els prompts; no és una lectura cega ni una validació amb participants.
